title: Winners for Shibby's Art Scavenger Hunt (ORIGINAL)
description: Entries to the Shibby Art Scavenger Hunt Competition have now concluded and winners have been drawn. Thank you to everyone who took part and wrote lovely messages along with your submissions. I'm really pleased you enjoyed going through and matching up each artwork with the corresponding clues. It was hard and intentionally cryptic! So, very well done if you managed to get 14/20 upwards, that is quite the achievement. The most common correct answer that 99% of you managed to guess correctly was "Marital Bliss", closely followed by "Worshipping your Goddess". By contrast, the most difficult clue turned out to be "Claimed" which only 37% of you managed to correctly identify. Without further ado, the winners of the Shibby Art Scavenger Hunt Competition who managed to correctly pair up every single artwork with their corresponding clue are: Sal, Carl and Creed Congratulations on your brand new and exclusive Shibby Bondage Sets! Once again, thank you for everyone who took part and I hope you had as much fun playing detective as I had making it in the first place. For those of you who are eager to finally find out the answers and figure out just how close you were to getting everything correct, they are as follows: 1) Mindless for Latex 2) Worshipping your Goddess 3) The File That Never Was 4) Shibby’s First Fan Art 5) It Starts With Sorry 6) Clever Girls 7) Put A Bow On It 8) Encased In My Gaze 9) You’re Fucked 10) Hi or Lo 11) Etched Loyalty 12) Claimed 13) She Protecc 14) My Sweet Boy 15) Tapped Out 16) Whose A Good Girl? 17) Close to My Heart 18) Orgasmic Contributions 19) Marital Bliss 20) Pulling You Down Deeper
author: Mistress Shibby
